blocks.doc: The main lighting material. Confirmed against clutter/barrel01.nif block 8. The material scalars after textureSet are named where SCT's NifDocument already reads them (emissive color and multiple, glossiness, specular color and strength); each word's type was checked on the corpus. The leading u32 is the shader type: across the SSE corpus it takes 10 values (0-6, 11, 14, 16) and the block size is a function of it alone. The NiObjectNET fields (name, extra data, controller) follow it, so this class can't inherit NiObjectNET's layout.
